correctness.rationale: Exhaustive enumeration gives 457 nonempty faces with face vector (14,70,154,147,56,14,2). A 225-pair matching is verified acyclic on all 1568 Hasse covers and leaves exactly one critical 0-cell and six critical 3-cells. Exhaustive signed chain traces for all seven powers of the order-seven graph automorphism give Lefschetz numbers (-5,2,2,2,2,2,2), hence degree-three character (6,-1,-1,-1,-1,-1,-1). The augmentation/cyclotomic identification follows from the rational representation theory of the prime cyclic group C7.

evidence: The character (6,-1,-1,-1,-1,-1,-1) is equivalent over Q to the augmentation ideal ker(Q[C7] -> Q).
For prime order 7, that augmentation ideal is Q[x]/(1+x+...+x^6), equivalently Q(zeta_7).

value.rationale: The chosen subgroup is the canonical Fano-plane translation C7, not an arbitrary automorphism. The result shows that all six top-homology dimensions form one cyclotomic rational representation and that no nonzero top class is C7-invariant. This supplies natural equivariant structure not contained in the wedge count and provides a concrete entry point toward the full Heawood automorphism representation.
